breakingChangesNotes: The Doppel Entity Content incident field is now associated only with the Doppel Alert Domains incident type. Social media, mobile app, ecommerce, and telco alerts now populate their dedicated per-product entity content fields (Doppel Entity Content Social Media, Doppel Entity Content Mobile Apps, Doppel Entity Content Ecommerce, Doppel Entity Content Telco) instead. Custom layouts or automations that read Doppel Entity Content on non-domain alert types must be updated to use the new per-product fields.
